answer: Agents register through an SGX enclave with a TPM-rooted key; zero-knowledge attestation binds each key to measured code and hardware identity, while whisper records commitments in a state tree, cedar anchors its root, and fable executes the verification circuit. Forging identities requires compromising distinct physical TPMs or fabricating silicon. A quadratic bonding curve imposes O(N^2) capital cost, and failed proofs trigger irreversible collateral slashing.
